label: D2 arrival at S2 after choosing a1 (rare a1->S2), late in the episode
explanation: Fires only at D2 and only when the state input is S2 (100% of activations); never at D1/GO or at S1. 90% of activations are on rare a1->S2 transitions; the remaining 10% (including many of the very top activations) are common a2->S2 arrivals right after a trial that chose a1 (a switch from a1). Strongly gated by episode position: essentially silent before ep_trial ~50 and rising steadily to trial 99, and active only when the value head is low (<7.5). Adding (action==1)|(prev_action==1) raises mass recall to 0.97 at F1 0.56. Precision is limited (~0.44): many rare a1->S2 D2 steps late in the episode stay silent, so some hidden-state context not captured here also gates it. All variables used are observed at D2.
